name: The Borg
author: neostryder
description:
Angband's automatic player, ported from 4.2.6's borg/. It plays the way you do - through the same commands, over the frozen agent API - so it is a mod like any other rather than privileged code inside the engine.

Installing it does not hand it your character: switch on "Let the Borg play" below and it takes the keyboard from the next turn. It is deterministic and draws only its own seeded generator, so it does not flag your save as non-reproducible. Only one autoplayer can hold the keyboard at a time.

rules.title: Let the Borg play
rules.description: Hand the Borg your character. It perceives the level, decides, and issues commands on its own, following the same priority ladder as upstream Angband's borg: avoid death, recover, fight, improve gear, take loot, explore, descend. Off by default, because enabling a mod and giving away the keyboard are different decisions.

rules.title: Play risky
rules.description: borg_plays_risky. Skip the early hit-point and character-level gates that hold the Borg above a depth, wait longer before drinking a cure, and back away later in a losing fight. It reaches deeper sooner and dies more.

rules.title: Value melee and missile damage
rules.description: borg_worships_damage. Add weight to weapon and bow damage when the Borg scores a set of gear, so a trade that costs armour for damage looks better than it otherwise would.

rules.title: Value speed
rules.description: borg_worships_speed. Add weight to a speed bonus when scoring gear.

rules.title: Value hit points
rules.description: borg_worships_hp. Add weight to constitution and hit points when scoring gear.

rules.title: Value spell points
rules.description: borg_worships_mana. Add weight to spell points when scoring gear. Nothing for a warrior, who has none.

rules.title: Value armour class
rules.description: borg_worships_ac. Add weight to armour class when scoring gear.

rules.title: Value gold
rules.description: borg_worships_gold. Sell harder, walk down rather than pay for a recall, and put off the first deep recall. It buys better equipment sooner and spends longer in town doing it. Upstream stops applying this past character level 20.

rules.title: Save up for something it wants
rules.description: borg_self_scum. Let the Borg set itself a gold target and work in town until it can afford one item it has decided it needs. It only does this from character level 10, with a permanent light source and food in the pack.

rules.title: Skimp on stockpiles for an early munchkin run
rules.description: borg_munchkin_start. Below character level borg_munchkin_level (12), stop valuing potions of resist poison and speed, phase door, word of recall and the deeper cure stockpiles as highly as it normally would, on the assumption that a young character is cashing out rather than settling in. Upstream also has the Borg stair-scum for loot to sell at this stage; that half is not ported, so this changes only what it carries, not how it dives.
